text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Cute Curren Chaaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a part of the academy's PR efforts, today's training is open to the public. Curren Chan is as popular as ever, but…

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Uh… I came here 'cause I can, but I really don't get what's going on…

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Me neither. I barely watch races anyway. Wanna head out?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Ehe! ♪ I've got it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, can we change up the order a bit? I wanna do those thirty hell sprints right now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, can we change up the order a bit? I wanna do those thirty hell sprints right now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Weeell, I thought I'd give everyone the okay to film it. And then…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Time to start Curren Chan's Thirty Sprint Challenge! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooo! You got this, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yahhh!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Wonder what's going on over there. Whoa! Look how fast she is! That's crazy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… All done! And I hit my target time! Mission accomplished! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe, and it's all thanks to all of your cheers! ♪ That's right, you! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Even after all those sprints… she smiles like an angel! And she's already trending on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah. ♪ Were you two cheering for me as well?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: Oh! Uh, um… You're so fast!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ☆ Thanks! ♪ If you're interested in racing, be sure to check me out! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! And since we got to meet today… why don't we shake hands? Squeeeze!

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: S-so cute! I didn't know racers could be this cute!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Y-your name's Curren Chan, right?! C-can you shake my hand too?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, I'm so jealous! I want a handshake too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really? That makes me so happy! ♪ This was supposed to be a surprise, but actually…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna do a meet and greet with everyone after training! Will you all come and shake my hand then?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm so there! I love you, Curren!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to finish training early so I can shake hands with everyone! Thanks for your support. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaa! Yay! You're so cute! Cute Curren Chan!
choice_data_list: You've got them eating out of the palm of your hands!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. A little teasing gets the OG fans excited. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's like she planned everything from the start! She ends up winning over new fans while making her original fans love her even more!
